SK10 is a free audio plugin that simulates a sub-kick microphone. A sub-kick mic is essentially a speaker converted into a microphone. 
Thanks to its diameter it captures a lot of low end and it's a perfect fit along your regular kick mic for boosting the low frequencies.

SnareBuzz is a free audio plugin that simulates the sympathetic resonances produced by the wires of a snare drum when another sound source is playing near.
Use it as a psycho-acoustic effect to bring realism and life to your tracks.
